body:
Implemented daily card counters with names, units, configured +/- steps and explicit OK. Dated totals live in card JSON; a new day shows zero without removing earlier results. Configuration, hide/restore and daily history are available in the card modal. Drafts survive ordinary edits, midnight and conflicts; retries retain the original command identity.

Verified the full local gate and five release Chromium suites, including mobile widths, lost responses and concurrent recording. Rebuilt and restarted the existing manual app; HTTPS serves the change and both projects validate. Source versions, pins and certificate were preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-09-26-daily-card-counters.md. Whole nonnegative numbers and one total per day are the initial behavior; physical-device acceptance remains open.

metadata.summary: Daily card counters implemented and verified
